I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread. I told him the records don't agree on the Brackenwater renewal date, so he should hold off on updating the account sheet, and I asked Ilse to confirm. The thread doesn't have a settled date yet.

- **25 November:** Ilse's 14 Oct post in #north-team.
- **30 November 2026:** the signed 2025–26 renewal order form gives this as the end of the current term. The Brackenwater account notes (last updated 30 Sep) also say 30 Nov.
- **31 December 2026:** a CRM note from February 2026. It doesn't match either of the others.

I couldn't find anything showing the date was moved to 25 November. My reply to Ilse on the 14th just accepted her date without checking it. That's why I flagged the difference now instead of repeating her date to Marcus.

Marcus is on the North team and owns the account, so the renewal date can be shared with him; it doesn't count as a finance figure. I only gave dates and left out the prices and discount in the order form.

The order form and CRM note came from the knowledge brain (gbrain), and neither appears in the shared files I can list. Marcus can see Ilse's post because he's in #north-team.
